That becomes difficult when customer information, process data, financial figures and market news all reside in different systems. Then discussions arise about which numbers are correct, while decisions actually need to be made faster.
Een AI data harness is een benadering om: An AI data harness is an approach to give systems and AI applications controlled access to relevant data, without having to copy all information first into a single new database. That can be a useful part of the solution. But mere access to data does not by itself create a better business. Value only arises when signals lead to decisions, actions and a demonstrable result.
Een verkoopteam ziet een daling in aanvr: A sales team sees a decline in inquiries, while the financial report is still from last month.
Inkoop signaleert een langere levertijd,: Purchasing signals a longer delivery time, but that information reaches planning too late. At the same time a supplier changes its terms or new regulations appear. Each signal seems manageable on its own. Together they can affect revenue, margin, delivery reliability and capacity.
In zulke situaties ontbreekt vaak niet d: In such situations it is often not the data that is missing, but the coherence. The organization has information in accounting,
, spreadsheets, projecttools en e-mail. Some sources are refreshed daily, others once a week. Figures have different definitions and no one knows exactly when a source was last checked. So when management asks for a forecast, it is unclear which starting point is reliable.
Het antwoord is niet automatisch een nie: The answer is not automatically a new data platform. Start with the business decision you want to improve. Which data is needed for that? Who is allowed to use it? How recent must it be? And how do you verify the outcome?

Een federatieve databenadering maakt het: A federated data approach makes it possible to query data from multiple systems without centralizing them all in advance.
Leverancier Zetaris kondigde op 6 oktobe: Vendor Zetaris announced on 6 October 2026 a cloud-based AI Data Harness that, according to the company, allows AI-agents to access distributed enterprise data with centralized policy and access control. This is a vendor announcement; the claimed performance has therefore not been independently verified.
De aankondiging illustreert een bredere: The announcement illustrates a broader development: the question is shifting from only choosing AI models to organizing reliable data usage. A model that quickly answers based on incomplete or outdated information remains a risk. Conversely, a well-designed data layer can improve reliability, provided rights, definitions and logging are checked.
Een harness neemt de strategische afwegi: A harness does not make the strategic trade-off for you. It does not automatically determine which customer is more important, whether an investment is justified, or which measure fits a risk. For that you need business goals, decision rules, ownership and feedback. Also, for each data source a judgment is still needed about privacy, data location, contractual agreements and security.
Een werkbare aanpak bestaat uit zeven st: A workable approach consists of seven steps.
Begin niet met tientallen AI-agents, maa: Don't start with dozens of AI-agents, but with one decision that recurs regularly and demonstrably affects money, quality or time.
Registreer wat er is veranderd. Dat kan: Record what has changed. This can be a price increase, a deviation in the schedule, a new customer request or a change in regulation. Capture the source, observation date and reliability.
Koppel het signaal aan de onderdelen van: Link the signal to the parts of your business that may be affected. Are they specific customers, contracts, products, employees or processes? Make clear what you do and do not know.
Werk met scenario's in plaats van één sc: Work with scenarios instead of one seemingly exact number. What changes in the case of a small, average or large impact? Think about cash flow, capacity, lead time and customer satisfaction.
Formuleer de keuze waarvoor iemand veran: Formulate the choice for which someone is responsible. Not: 'more insight needed', but for example: 'whether or not to order extra stock'. State the assumptions and the moment at which it will be reassessed.
Wijs een eigenaar aan, bepaal de volgend: Assign an owner, determine the next step, and make a deadline visible. A recommendation without an owner is not yet an implementation.
Meet wat daadwerkelijk is gebeurd. Is de: Measure what actually happened. Has the backlog decreased, has the error rate fallen, or has the expected financial impact changed? Keep prediction and realized outcome separate.
Leg vast welke aanname juist was, welke: Record which assumption was correct, which source is lacking, and which decision rule must be adjusted. That way the next decision is better substantiated.
Deze werkwijze maakt AI onderdeel van ee: This approach makes AI part of an improvement process. Not because an algorithm is always right, but because the organization can visibly check how a recommendation was formed and what was done with it.
Stel dat een belangrijke leverancier mel: Suppose a key supplier reports that delivery time will likely increase. In a traditional process procurement hears the news, planning processes a change later, and finance only sees the consequences in the next report.
Met een verbonden informatie- en besluit: With a connected information and decision process, procurement can record the external signal and link it to current orders. Planning shows which orders are at risk. Finance calculates possible consequences for inventory, expedited transport and cash flow. The responsible manager sees several scenarios with their assumptions. After that the manager chooses an action, for example inform customers, reallocate inventory or investigate an alternative.
Het systeem mag de vertraging niet prese: The system must not present the delay as a definite loss if there is not yet evidence for that. A prediction remains a prediction. Only after execution and measurement can the organization assess whether the chosen measure worked.
Een extern artikel, een handmatig spread: An external article, a manual spreadsheet and a direct ERP signal do not automatically have the same evidentiary weight. Show origin and recency, and mark missing or conflicting data.
Een AI-model moet niet méér gegevens ont: An AI model should not receive more data than is necessary for the task. Check per source the authorization, retention period and any transfer to external AI providers. A federated architecture does not relieve you of that responsibility.
Laat AI suggesties en scenario's voorber: Let AI prepare suggestions and scenarios, but explicitly designate who may approve a significant decision. Especially for personnel, contracts, finance and compliance, post‑hoc control must remain possible.
Houd bij welk signaal tot welke actie le: Keep track of which signal led to which action, who executed it and what was measured. Otherwise the number of automations grows without anyone being able to demonstrate whether the company has benefited.
Kies één terugkerende bedrijfsbeslissing: Choose one recurring business decision, for example capacity planning or tracking declining margins. Determine three to five relevant sources. Note the definition of each figure, how often it is refreshed and who is responsible. Then create one overview that brings together the signal, the expectation, the action owner and the result.
De gedachte achter Bedrijfsgeheugen is o: The idea behind Bedrijfsgeheugen is to connect internal knowledge and external developments with daily business management. Brein, Powerhouse and Heartbeat are not meant to function as separate dashboards, but as parts of the same route from information to follow-up. Whether that route works well in a particular organization must be shown by real source measurements, executed actions and demonstrable results; a nice screen or a generated recommendation is not sufficient for that.
Wil je beginnen, stel dan deze vraag in: If you want to start, ask this question at your management meeting: which important decision from last week was difficult because information was too late, incomplete or contradictory? That is often a better starting point than buying another AI tool.
